title: 第7章 信不信我今天撕烂你第8章 谢礼
slug: 漂亮后妈要翻身我在七零养崽崽
content_zh:
旁边的陆文渊则紧紧握起了小拳头，也跟著抹起了眼泪。
他们年纪小，从来没有人为他们出过头。
因为只要是有人敢替他们出头，陆红武一家能在村子里骂个三天三夜不带停的。
时间一长，没人敢碰这个硬茬子。
兄妹三人从来到陆家的三年里，因为爸爸作战任务繁重没有回来过，他们三年里就没吃过一顿饱饭。
因为陆老太太开始破口大骂，陆家的院子里早就挤满了来看热闹的村民，听著苏灿的话很多人都跟著点头。
“这三个孩子太可怜了，从来到咱们桃村哪里吃过一顿饱饭？”
“就是，做人不能太过分了，会遭天谴的。”
“人家陆战东寄回来的那些津贴，孩子哪里得著一分了？”
“早就该有人治治他们了。”
“我觉得这个三媳妇不错，这种时候能帮战东家说话。”
“我看这老三家的要是真去县公安局，老陆家还真得有人要去坐牢。”
村民们七嘴八舌，毕竟陆战东和三个孩子的日子什么样，大家全都一清二楚。
陆老太太看著自己被砸碎的水缸，原本想嚎丧的，可是听著苏灿的指责，还要去县公安局告自己，顿时有些怕了。
“老嫂子，人家老三媳妇说的对。前几天我去开会，上面的人还说过，谁要是敢虐待军人和军人的家属，那可是要吃牢饭的。”
旁边的周支书看著地上的陆老太太语重心长地提醒。
“我们已经分过家了，还分什么分？你这个女人要是再多说一句嘴，信不信我今天撕烂你？”
陆家老二陆红武握著拳头，瞪著一双牛眼指著苏灿的鼻子骂。
他可是村子里出了名的莽夫，生的五大三粗，平常在村子里没人敢招惹的主。
他扯著嗓子一吼，周围的人都有些怕了。

有些人开始为苏灿担心，毕竟她一个大胖子，论武力是不可能打过这个大老爷们的。
“好呀！那你就来撕烂我好了！”
苏灿说著看向看热闹的村民们：“你们大家今天正好给我当个见证，我叔可是县公安局的，今天他要打死我，等到我叔来的时候，你们记得给陆战东和三个孩子证明一下。我死不死的没关係，如果我死了能把这个家给分了，也算是值了。”
其实这话她还真不是瞎说，因为陆战东和杨雅丽的这门婚事，原本就是县公安局方局长牵的线。
杨家和方局长都是住在同一个大院里，加上原主的体格太胖，在大院里也算是个“名人”了。
只是因为姜玉容爱惜自己的面子，平常基本不让她出门罢了。
但她只要出门，大院里的人都知道她是谁家的孩子。
“满嘴放屁！你叔要是公安局的，你怎么可能嫁到我们这种山旮旯里来！”
陆红武其实心里有些怕了，但是他向来在这个村子里横惯了，不可能一下子就对这个女人低头。
苏灿听他的话冷笑了一下：“你是不是觉得我这个身材隨便一个普通人家就能养出来？如果我们家生活条件不好，我能吃这么胖吗？我嫁到这里来，是因为陆战东他是个军人。是我爸在部队的关係，我才认识了陆战东！”
苏灿的话一出，村民们立即议论纷纷。
俗话说远路的和尚会念经，苏灿刚刚这番话还真就唬住了一些人。
content_en:
Lu Wenyuan next to him clenched his fists tightly and wiped away tears.
They were young and no one had ever stood up for them.
Because as long as someone dares to stand up for them, Lu Hongwu's family can scold them in the village for three days and three nights without stopping.
As time went by, no one dared to touch this hard problem.
In the three years since the three brothers and sisters came to the Lu family, their father never came back because of his heavy combat mission. They had not had a full meal in the past three years.
Because Mrs. Lu started to curse, the courtyard of the Lu family was already crowded with villagers who came to watch the fun. Many people nodded after listening to Su Can's words.
"These three children are so pitiful. Where have they ever had a full meal in our Taocun Village?"
"That is, you can't go too far as a human being, or you will be punished by God."
"How can the child get any of the subsidies Lu Zhandong sent back?"
"It's long past time for someone to deal with them."
"I think this third daughter-in-law is good. She can help Zhan Dong's family at this time."
"I think if the third brother really goes to the county police station, someone from the old Lu family will really have to go to jail."
The villagers were all talking about it. Everyone knew exactly what Lu Zhandong was doing with his three children.
Old Mrs. Lu looked at her smashed water tank and originally wanted to cry out in mourning, but when she heard Su Can's accusations and the fact that she wanted to go to the county public security bureau to sue her, she suddenly became a little scared.
"Sister-in-law, my third daughter-in-law is right. I went to a meeting a few days ago, and the people above also said that anyone who dares to abuse soldiers and their families will go to jail."
Party Secretary Zhou next to him looked at Old Mrs. Lu on the ground and reminded her earnestly.
"We have already separated, what else is there to separate? If you, a woman, say one more word, believe it or not, I will tear you to pieces today?"
The second eldest son of the Lu family, Lu Hongwu, clenched his fists, stared at Su Can's nose with a pair of bull's eyes, and cursed.
He is a famously reckless man in the village. He is a rough-and-tumble man who no one dares to provoke in the village.
He roared at the top of his lungs, and everyone around him became a little scared.
Some people began to worry about Su Can. After all, she was a big fat person and it was impossible for her to defeat this big man in terms of force.
"Okay! Then come and tear me apart!"
Su Can said and looked at the villagers watching the excitement: "You all are here to be witnesses for me today. My uncle is from the county public security bureau. He is going to beat me to death today. When my uncle comes, remember to prove it to Lu Zhandong and the three children. It doesn't matter whether I die or not. If I die, I can divide this family, and it will be worthwhile."
In fact, she was really not talking nonsense, because the marriage between Lu Zhandong and Yang Yali was originally the result of the director of the County Public Security Bureau.
The Yang family and Director Fang both live in the same compound, and the original owner is too fat, so he is considered a "celebrity" in the compound.
It's just because Jiang Yurong cherishes her face and usually doesn't let her go out.
But whenever she goes out, everyone in the compound knows whose child she is.
"You're full of farts! If your uncle is from the Public Security Bureau, how could you possibly marry into a remote mountain village like ours!"
Lu Hongwu was actually a little scared, but he had always been used to it in this village, and it was impossible for him to bow to this woman all of a sudden.
Su Can sneered after hearing his words: "Do you think an ordinary person with my figure can raise me? If our family's living conditions were not good, could I be so fat? I married here because Lu Zhandong is a soldier. It was my father's relationship in the army that made me meet Lu Zhandong!"
As soon as Su Can's words came out, the villagers immediately started talking.
As the saying goes, monks who travel far can recite sutras. Su Can's words just now really frightened some people.
